split_7mm.caption: The lettering under this arm, measured 2026-09-30 on the engine that drew these pairs (main after #577, #578 and #579), shipped → arm where they differ, one figure where they agree; each logo at its own width and garment, max_colors=6. The lettering columns read the satin runs of text_candidate shapes only: legs are a cross and its return leg between consecutive rail points; split % is the share of legs with a mid-column penetration; changes counts the split state flipping between consecutive legs (the flicker); holes/100 legs is mid-column penetrations per hundred legs (what the needle-holes toggle shows); jitter is the share of consecutive legs whose length differs by more than 0.15 mm (a rail step); turn p90 is the 90th percentile of the angle change between consecutive legs (the cross swinging). thermal is drone's artwork byte for byte and is not repeated.
